C1280.title: Using AI to Generate 'News' and Publish Nearly 100,000 Fake Stories Leads to Public Prosecution
C1280.summary: Xu, Luo, Kan, and others operated an information technology company that used specific software to spin hot online content, publishing nearly 100,000 fake stories and making over 55,000 yuan in illegal profits.
